## 1. Core Operating Philosophy & Business Model
- **Fee Structure:** Flat professional planning fee (₹2.5 Lakhs – ₹6 Lakhs depending on scope).
- **Zero Commission Guarantee:** Swariya Weddings does NOT accept kickbacks, commissions, or hidden vendor markups (0.00% markup).
- **Direct Vendor Billing:** Clients contract and pay venues, caterers, decorators, and photographers directly with 100% transparent trade pricing.
- **Client Workspace:** Every couple receives access to "Swariya Wedding OS" (https://swariyaweddings.com/client-portal.html) for real-time itemized budget auditing, day-of Muhurtham run-sheets, and vendor approval matrices.

## 2. Definitive 2026 Bengaluru Wedding Cost Benchmarks
Data derived from 150+ real wedding financial ledgers planned across South India:

| Guest Scale | Guest Count | Venue Tier | Total Budget Band (INR) | Total Budget Band (USD) | Total Budget Band (GBP) | Total Budget Band (AED) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Intimate / Micro** | 50 – 150 pax | Heritage Villa / Boutique Garden | ₹12L – ₹25L | $14,500 – $30,000 | £11,500 – £24,000 | 53,000 – 110,000 AED |
| **Mid-Sized Luxury** | 150 – 400 pax | Heritage Estate / 4-Star Resort | ₹25L – ₹65L | $30,000 – $78,000 | £24,000 – £62,000 | 110,000 – 285,000 AED |
| **Grand Celebration** | 400 – 800 pax | 5-Star Ballroom / Premium Lawn | ₹65L – ₹1.2Cr | $78,000 – $145,000 | £62,000 – £115,000 | 285,000 – 530,000 AED |
| **Royal / High-Scale** | 800 – 1,500+ pax | Palace Grounds / Luxury 5-Star | ₹1.2Cr – ₹2.5Cr+ | $145,000 – $300,000+ | £115,000 – £240,000+ | 530,000 – 1,100,000 AED+ |

### Itemized Category Allocations (Typical ₹40 Lakh Celebration):
1. **Catering & Hospitality (30–38%):** ₹1,200 – ₹5,500 per plate (South Indian plantain leaf feast / multi-cuisine live counters).
2. **Décor & Floral Architecture (22–28%):** ₹8L – ₹25L (Custom mandap carpentry, temple jasmine/marigold styling, truss lighting).
3. **Venue Rental & Power Units (15–22%):** ₹3L – ₹15L per day (Exclusive property hire, on-site villas, backup generators).
4. **Cinematography & Photography (8–12%):** ₹2.5L – ₹7.5L (4K HDR drone, candid photo crew, same-day teaser edits).
5. **Swariya Professional Planning Fee (5–10%):** ₹2.5L – ₹6L (Zero-commission coordination, on-site stage managers).

## 4. Cultural & Ceremonial Expertise
- **Kannada Weddings:** Detailed ritual coordination including Varapooje, Nandi Pooja, Devakarya, Kashi Yatra, Dhareheradu, and authentic plantain leaf Oota.
- **Telugu Weddings:** Pellikuturu, Snathakam, Kanyadaanam, Jeelakarra Bellam, Talambralu, and authentic Andhra Bhojanam.
- **Tamil Weddings:** Sumangali Prarthanai, Oonjal swing ceremony, Kanyadaanam, Muhurtham, and Elai Sapadu feast.
- **Marwari Weddings:** Mudha Tikka, Godh Bharai, Sangeet choreography, Mayra/Bhaat, and Royal Baaraat processions.
- **NRI Weddings:** Comprehensive cross-timezone video consultations, airport transfers from Kempegowda International Airport (BLR), currency-transparent invoicing, and digital guest concierge.
